title: Should've checked the size before I bought this.
text: Should've checked the size before I bought this.. It is just as pictured but it's really big I was hoping to find a smaller sized one and I didn't notice or cared to check I just assumed it was small to medium-ish sized, that is a mistake on my part but I honestly think it is very big and not very practical for my kitchen I was not expecting to get this size so now I don't have a place to store it also I don't like how heavy it is, makes it very difficult to move around and in my opinion difficult since it does heat up I'm not sure I'd like to get burnt with this... hopefully it will never fall on my feet. No I would not buy this again, check the sizing before buying, I still have to use it though so I will update after I use it and see how it works I don't think it's completely fair to say this before I use it as well but now I am even scared to use it too, cause at the same time I'd say it's a potential hazard with the handle and all and that size imagine it just slipping out of your hands while you pour it.
